titulo: Quiz — Make the trip survive offline
subtitulo: Close the reservation gaps before the airport
introPt: A traveller checks the hotel the night before flying. Listen for the three details that make the reservation usable after the phone loses signal.
cenario: The hotel has the booking, but the traveller still needs a portable confirmation, complete address and late-arrival answer.

dialogo.pt: I want to confirm my reservation.

dialogo.es: ¿Me puede mandar la confirmación por correo? ¿Cuál es la dirección completa?
dialogo.pinyin: meh PWEH-deh mahn-DAHR lah kohn-feer-mah-SYOHN por koh-REH-oh. kwahl ehs lah dee-rehk-SYOHN kohm-PLEH-tah
dialogo.pt: Can you send me the confirmation by email? What is the complete address?

dialogo.es: Llego después de las diez. ¿Hay recepción las veinticuatro horas?
dialogo.pinyin: YEH-goh dehs-PWEHS deh lahs DYEHS. eye reh-sehp-SYOHN lahs bayn-tee-KWAH-troh OH-rahs
dialogo.pt: I arrive after ten. Is reception open twenty-four hours?

perguntas.pergunta: Why request the confirmation by email?
opcoes: To keep a copy outside the booking app
perguntas.explica: The lesson makes the booking portable and available offline.

perguntas.pergunta: Which document can a U.S. traveller use to board an international flight to Mexico?
perguntas.explica: Air entry requires the passport book; the card is not valid for boarding the flight.

perguntas.pergunta: Does visa-free tourism guarantee a 180-day stay?
opcoes: No; immigration determines the authorised period at entry
perguntas.explica: Under 180 days is the visa-free category's ceiling, not an automatic grant.

perguntas.pergunta: What does the complete address protect?
opcoes: The trip when the app or signal fails
perguntas.explica: A saved full address remains usable by the traveller, driver and offline map.

perguntas.pergunta: What unresolved risk remains after the booking is found?
opcoes: The front desk may close before a late arrival
perguntas.explica: The traveller explicitly checks whether reception is available after ten.
